name: docs-only-pr
query: /review a PR that only edits files under docs/ and one README
expected_behavior: Runs review-state.mjs first and gets mode full, round 1
Classifies the PR as docs-only but still activates the always-on concerns
Validates a plan with --plan before dispatching any worker
Does not load the React or Go pattern sections
Renders the report with review-report.mjs and stops for user approval without posting to GitHub

name: security-sensitive-pr
query: /review a PR that changes a GitHub workflow's permissions and a URL allowlist in src/security/
expected_behavior: Marks a dedicated security plan entry with specialist: security
Counts the security specialist against the general worker slots
Loads Canonical observation via --section before dispatching workers
Takes every disposition from review-policy.mjs and ignores any clean/minor/blocking label from the security skill
Does not publish the review before explicit user approval

name: incremental-round-three
query: /review a PR that already has two prior reviews by this reviewer, each with a valid v2 marker, and two new commits
expected_behavior: Runs review-state.mjs with --prior-body and --prior-review-count and uses its mode and round without recomputing them
Reads INCREMENTAL.md
Reviews only diff_range and verifies every prior blocker and deferred entry at the current head
Uses at most one general observation worker
Emits no new suggestions or nits at round three or later

name: contract-evolution-gate-fires
query: /review a PR that modifies a named contract anchor in a subsystem with at least two consumers
expected_behavior: Reads CONTRACT_EVOLUTION.md and runs contract-evolution-gate.mjs with literal SHAs and a concern id
Sets touches_anchor_with_consumers from the diff itself
Passes the gate to the plan as contract_evolution and runs at most one specialist
Runs contract-evolution-policy.mjs on the specialist packet and does not treat its output as a disposition
Emits a documentation-drift defect if the PR body does not say whether it follows, extends, or replaces the contract
